title: Smoother Evia movement
details: Evia now moves between the home position and the open menu with the same timing and easing as Milos
The menu fades and settles while Evia moves instead of appearing or disappearing abruptly
Returning home now keeps the menu fade, avatar travel and home prompt synchronised
The updated motion files are forced into the new offline cache so installed Evia does not keep the older clunky animation
